findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Gate. The new allowance covers caching the internal command parser in cli.py, but the selected diff also changes binary review in src/forge/review.py, workflow event delivery in src/forge/mod/hooks/events.ts, and the required tests gate in src/forge/prcheck.py. These address different problems, so the allowance's reason does not match the whole diff.
findings.title: Gate: parser-cache allowance does not cover the mixed change

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. If a failure is queued during a busy turn and its workflow reruns within 60 seconds, forge board can still return the cached failed occurrence (src/forge/board.py:104). The new `latest.has(id)` check then accepts that stale occurrence and submits the failure. The rerun test advances FORGE_NOW by a full minute between snapshots (tests/test_mod_plugin.py:248), so it does not cover this normal sequence.
findings.title: A queued CI failure can be delivered after a rerun within the cache window
